subject: Cross-border routing and deployment constraints for MedFin (post-call recap)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>

Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-12-13T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Quick recap + clarifying residency requirement

Hi Karim / Sana — great to meet yesterday. Thanks for walking us through the MedFin use cases (real-time underwriting + anonymized analytics pipelines). Per the call, I wanted to confirm a couple of items so we can recommend the right deployment approach (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC).

1) Residency must be EU-only for processing and storage for all production customer data. No cross-border replication of PII to the US is allowed.
2) APAC operations (Singapore office) should be able to send inference requests with low-latency — you prefer either a dedicated APAC pool or a private APAC deployment depending on cost.
3) You're open to a hybrid approach: Private VPC for EU production (to satisfy legal controls) + Dedicated capacity in APAC for latency and throughput.

Action items I took away:
- We’ll validate EU-only hosting options and whether Hosted API can be configured to guarantee no cross-region replication for EU datasets.
- Stephanie will scope Dedicated capacity estimates for APAC traffic (qps / concurrent sessions).
- MedFin to confirm expected qps and whether any historical logs must be stored within EU for >90 days.

I’m attaching a short hosting-options 1-pager and the SOC2 / residency checklist so you can mark any must-haves.

Next: Stephanie and I will run a quick feasibility note and cost delta (Hosted EU-only vs Private EU VPC) and share by EOD Tuesday.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Quick recap + clarifying residency requirement

Thanks Tessa — that summary looks right. A few clarifications from our side:

- Residency: EU-only is non-negotiable for production inference and storage. That includes any replication for backups or audit logs. We can accept log exports to an external SIEM if they are stripped of PII and routed to an EU region.
- APAC: latency SLAs are soft — <150ms preferred. If Dedicated APAC is significantly cheaper than a separate private deployment, we'd consider that.
- qps: Peak expected is ~120 qps for underwriting flows (bursty) and a sustained 30 qps for analytics.
- Retention: Anonymized inference outputs for analytics must live in EU for 180 days.

Also, procurement will want to see a list of controls for the Private VPC option (KMS, audit logs locations, ingress/egress controls). Sana, I’ve looped you for procurement items.

—Karim
CTO, MedFin

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-12-14T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: feasibility + cost sketch for MedFin (EU private vs Hosted EU-only)

Tessa / Rishi — quick internal note following Karim’s reply.

Options (high level):
- Hosted API (EU-only tenancy + region-restriction feature): fastest onboarding; low ops overhead; can we guarantee no replica to US for backups? Need confirmation from infra but we have precedents where we can disable cross-region backups and lock logs to EU buckets with customer-managed KMS.
- Private VPC (EU): meets legal, full control over network; longer lead time (4–8 weeks deployment + network peering), additional infra fee and enterprise licensing. Better for audit evidence and HSM/KMS integration.
- Dedicated APAC pool: reservation for burst capacity in APAC region; cost predictable; requires routing policy so APAC traffic goes to APAC-only GPUs.

Questions for Rishi / infra:
1) Can Hosted API offer a contract-level guarantee (and enforceable config) to prevent cross-region backups of customer tenant data?
2) If we do Private VPC for EU, can we offer a managed update window and explain patching cadence (for procurement)?

I’ll draft a short matrix with tradeoffs + rough cost delta. Tessa, happy to co-sign.

-Steph

Subject: Re: Internal: feasibility + cost sketch for MedFin (EU private vs Hosted EU-only)

Thanks — quick infra answers for the matrix:

1) Hosted API EU-only tenancy: we can enforce tenant-level regional lock for data at rest and backups. By default our snapshot replication is configurable per-tenant; for MedFin we can mark "no-cross-region-replication" and ensure snapshots land only in EU buckets with the customer-managed KMS. We can build a contract addendum (SLA + operational controls) documenting that.

2) Private VPC: can provide KMS/HSM integration, full audit log retention in-customer EU S3, and restricted egress. Timeline: 6 weeks typical with network approvals + testing. Managed patching cadence: monthly security patches; emergency hotfixes as needed.

3) Routing: we can create routing policies so APAC-origin traffic routes to Dedicated APAC pools (no data routed to EU). That means inference payloads from APAC will never touch EU storage. Edge case: if you need model weight sync, that can be handled via explicit replication process controlled by MedFin.

Cost hint: Private VPC carries a platform license + infra; estimate ~2.2x Hosted EU-only over a 12-month baseline for the qps you mentioned. Dedicated APAC pool pricing will depend on reserved hours; I’ll work with Stephanie on a 12-month commitment estimate.

Next steps (agreed):
- Stephanie: deliver matrix + cost delta by EOD Tuesday (Dec 15).
- Tessa: send procurement/SOC2 checklist (done).
- Karim / Sana: confirm whether backups / audit logs can be excluded from cross-region replication (you already said yes for backups if stripped — please confirm for production backups).

Rishi
Director, Infrastructure Ops
Redwood Inference
